text: Verified audit evidence: Event.Saccade.of rejects empty spans, but Saccade.between constructs directly and Scanpath.saccades currently certifies a zero-duration event for abutting fixations. EventSeries.of upgrades declared summaries to SourceSupported without proving the summary matches its range. EventSeries.supported, SampleSupportLedger.apply, SampleLabels.apply, and AoiAssignment.apply are partial public pure accessors.
